t: Aratan - Middle-Earth Encyclopedia
s: Aratan was the second son of Isildur. He was born in year 3339 of the Second Age in Gondor. His older brother was Elendur and his two younger brothers were Ciryon and Valandil. Aratan had an uncle named Anarion who shared the rule of Gondor with Isildur, and a grandfather named Elendil who ruled both Gondor and Arnor in the north.
